id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying forbidden monday com syncs

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion reliability for Monday.com connector, specifically distinguishing permission denials (403) from authentication failures to prevent unnecessary retry loops.
review.reason: The change adds a 403 Forbidden error to the set of non-retryable errors alongside existing 401 and GraphQL auth errors, and includes a corresponding user-facing message. This is a substantive, bounded correctness improvement for warehouse ingestion: it prevents unnecessary retry loops for requests that will not succeed, distinguishing permission denials from authentication issues.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on whether Monday.com returns 403 for permission issues in the specific warehouse ingestion context, which is not independently verified by this patch alone.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.
